# Card Change Pair

Card Workflows · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/card-change-pair`

Real consumers: **2** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

A resolved before-and-after card presentation for replacements, copies, Transfigurations, keyword changes, and card-type changes.

> **Guidance:** Display a completed mutation here; never ask this component to perform one.

Both entry IDs and card UUIDs remain semantic diagnostics, even when display names collide.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `CardChangePairModel<ChangeId>` | yes | — | Complete resolved change to display. |
| `reveal` | `"before" \| "complete"` | yes | — | Controlled choreography phase for concealing or revealing the result. |

## Usage

```tsx
<CardChangePair model={resolvedChange} reveal="complete" />
```
